newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen continuing to climb.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen continuing to climb.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks, which opened firm on Wednesday, are expected to continue moving up as investors expect good corporate results throughout the current financial year, brokers said.

"Good profits up to June have taken the all share index to almost 850 points, at which point selling seems to be entering. But there is enough buying to limit the downside," said Dimuthu Abeysekera of Allied Phillips Securities.
The all share index closed at 849.3 points on Tuesday on turnover of 100.9 million rupees.
The Colombo bourse has gained more than 240 points this year on improved sentiment and good corporate results up to June.
"Buyers seem to be motivated by expectations of even better corporate results in the latter part of the year," said Abeysekera.
